name: Sensei, Ha○mi-chan ga Imasen!
original_name: 先生、は○みちゃんがいません!
source:
To the school that lost track of a girl on a fieldtrip, it's a calamity.
To the man who lured her with a special drink, it's a jackpot. 


[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE167732.html]DLSite english[/url]]
translation:
对于在一次实地考察中失去女孩踪迹的学校来说，这是一场灾难。
对于那个用特殊饮料引诱她的男人来说，这是一个大奖。


[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE167732.html]DLSite english[/url]]
